sloka: स योजनसहस्राणि समतीत्य महाकपिः।दिव्यौषधिधरं शैलं व्यचरन्मारुतात्मजः ।। ६.७४.६३ ।।
transliteration: sa yojanasahasrāṇi samatītya mahākapiḥ।divyauṣadhidharaṁ śailaṁ vyacaranmārutātmajaḥ ।। 6.74.63 ।।

translations.english: Perceiving a seeker coming for them, the herbs all over the wonderful mountain disappeared.
